title: TRACE
subtitle: Your Diffusion Model Is Secretly an Instance Edge Detector

observation.head: Diffusion self-attention briefly reveals instance-level structure
observation.note: Paper Fig. 1(a) · attention maps of a text-to-image diffusion model during the reverse process (τ: denoising timestep)
observation.timeline: Reverse process · prompt: "Two Cats" · from noise to the image
messages: Early in denoising (τ = 999), self-attention is almost indistinguishable from noise
At τ = 699, self-attention separates the two cats into different colours
At τ = 499, the two cats share one colour again: instance structure turns into semantic content
Cross-attention remains semantic at every step, even with the prompt
Instance cues appear in self-attention at specific steps of the denoising process
card: Cross-attention does not separate the two cats, even with the prompt.

emergence.head: Instance Emergence Point (IEP): the step where instance structure is most pronounced
emergence.note: Top: paper Fig. 1(b) and Eq. 1 · bottom: paper Fig. 8, top row (self-attention maps visualised with PCA)
emergence.timeline: Forward process on a real image · null-text prompt · from the image to noise
emergence.formula_text: IEP: the timestep t* where consecutive self-attention maps SA differ the most (KL divergence)
emergence.backbones_title: The same image in three diffusion backbones
messages: Inversion runs the other way: self-attention starts semantic (the two dogs share one colour)
One stride later (τ = 199), the map is still semantic
At τ = 399 the two dogs separate: the instance emergence point of this image
Further steps dissolve the structure into noise
With IEP, self-attention separates the two dogs in SD1.5, SDXL and SD3.5-L; without IEP it does not

edge.head: From self-attention to instance edges: ABDiv and one-step self-distillation
edge.note: Paper Figs. 1(b), 4 and 5, Eq. 2 · red marks: fragmented edges before training · green circles: closed after training · latency: Sec. 5
training: After training: Ê in one step

abdiv.title: Attention Boundary Divergence
abdiv.text: KL divergence between opposite neighbours of a pixel.

speed.title: One step at inference
speed.text: A single forward pass at t = 0 replaces the per-image IEP and ABDiv.

messages: The self-attention map at the emergence point, SA(X_{t*}), is the instance-aware representation
ABDiv turns it into a pseudo edge map E: the divergence is high on instance boundaries
One-step self-distillation: an edge decoder is trained with E as the pseudo label
During training, gaps in the fragmented edges close
After training, one forward pass predicts connected instance edges, without IEP or ABDiv

masks.head: Instance edges reconnect fragmented masks and separate adjacent objects
masks.note: Paper Fig. 2 (MaskCut) and Fig. 9(a) (DHR) · the white dotted marks are the paper's: corrected boundaries and converted regions

rows.effect: A semantic mask becomes a panoptic mask

messages: Existing methods merge adjacent objects of the same class or fragment single instances
TRACE predicts instance edges for the same images, without any annotation
Used as separators, the edges split merged regions along instance boundaries

results.head: Instance edges without prompts, points, boxes or masks
results.note: Paper Fig. 10, Table 6 (ODS: COCO 2014 val) and Sec. 6 (AP with each edge map in the same pipeline) · cards: Tables 1, 2 and 5, Sec. 5
results.strip_title: Top: edge map of each detector · bottom: the ProMerge mask refined with that edge map
cards: a single forward pass at t = 0
no IEP or ABDiv at inference
results.line: Instance edges decoded from a pretrained text-to-image diffusion model · no instance-level labels
messages: Conventional edge detectors respond to texture and intensity changes, not to instances
